;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**At least 43 people, mostly children, are killed in [[Dahyan air strike|an airstrike]] on a bus at a market in Dahyan, [[Saada Governorate|Sa'da]], by the [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen|Saudi-led coalition]], while more than 60 are injured. The coalition calls the strike a "legitimate military action" against the [[Houthi insurgency in Yemen|Houthis]], accusing them of using children as [[human shield]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/09/dozens-dead-in-yemen-as-bus-carrying-children-hit-by-airstrike-icrc (''The Guardian'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**At least 40 bodies of [[Afghan National Army]] soldiers are found in a military base in [[Urozgan Province|Urozgan]] that [[Taliban]] forces stormed last week. [http://www.euronews.com/2018/08/09/dozens-of-afghan-soldiers-killed-in-attack-on-base-last-week (Reuters via Euronews)]
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**Over 180 rockets and mortars are launched toward [[Israel]] by [[Hamas]] militants, injuring seven people. In retaliation, [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] launches an air assault on 150 targets in Gaza, in which three people are killed, including an 18-month-old child. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/09/middleeast/israel-gaza-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Hamas]]'s [[Al-Aqsa TV]] reports that a cease-fire is reached to end the latest round of fighting with [[Israel]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/hamas-claims-cease-fire-after-new-round-fighting-israel-n899426 (NBC News)] 

;Arts and culture
*[[Video game censorship]]
**[[Germany]] lifts a blanket ban on [[Nazi symbolism]] in [[video game]]s, including the [[swastika]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-lifts-ban-on-swastika-hitler-mustache-in-wolfenstein-video-game/a-45024101 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[August 2018 Lombok earthquake]]
**The death toll from the magnitude 6.9 [[earthquake]] in [[Lombok]], [[Indonesia]], rises to 259, and may go higher still. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45124972 (BBC)]
*[[Hurricane Maria]]
**[[Puerto Rico]] raises its official death toll from [[Hurricane Maria]] from 64 to 1,427. [https://www.kansascity.com/news/nation-world/article216361345.html (''The Kansas City Star'')]
*[[Bolivarian diaspora]]
**[[Ecuador]] declares a [[state of emergency]] over increases in migrant entry from [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/180809102416737.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Toronto]] sees severe flooding in many parts of the city after some areas receive over 100 millimeters of rain. [https://www.theweathernetwork.com/news/articles/toronto-swamped-by-torrential-rain-significant-flooding-flash-flood-photos-video/108070 (Weather Network)]

;Law and crime
*[[Abortion in Argentina]]
**The [[Argentine Senate]] rejects a bill that would have [[abortion law|legalized abortion]] in [[Argentina]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/08/09/636992391/argentinas-senate-rejects-legalizing-abortion-dashing-hopes-of-rights-advocates (NPR)]
*[[Illegal drug trade]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] police seize 20&nbsp;tonnes of [[hashish]] in a [[Panama]]-flagged, [[Montenegro|Montenegrin]]-crewed "research and survey" vessel's fuel tanks. [https://www.dw.com/en/italy-seizes-20-tons-of-hashish-hidden-in-ship-fuel-tanks/a-45018092 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Indonesian general election, 2019]]
**[[Indonesian President]] [[Joko Widodo]] chooses the Islamic cleric [[Ma'ruf Amin]] as his running mate in the upcoming presidential election. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-politics/indonesian-president-picks-cleric-as-running-mate-for-election-idUSKBN1KU0JF (Reuters)]
*[[Caracas drone explosions]]
**The [[2017 Constituent National Assembly|Venezuelan Constituent National Assembly]] revokes the [[Parliamentary immunity|immunity]] of opposition politicians [[Julio Borges]] and [[Juan Requesens]] after claiming that they were involved in an assassination plot on President [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/180809102416737.html (Al Jazeera)]
